title: Privacy Policy
content:
Privacy Policy

We value your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This privacy policy explains how we collect, use, and safeguard your data when you use our website and tools. By using our site, you agree to the terms outlined in this policy.

What Information We Collect

Information You Provide:

When you create an account, we collect information like your name, email address, and password. If you use our tools, we may collect the information you enter, such as project details, client information, and financial data.

Information We Automatically Collect:

We automatically collect information about your device and how you use our website, such as your IP address, browser type, and the pages you visit. We may use cookies and similar technologies to track your usage.

How We Use Your Information

To Provide Our Services: We use your information to provide you with access to our website and tools.

To Improve Our Services: We use your information to understand how you use our website and tools and to improve them.

To Communicate with You: We may use your email address to send you updates, notifications, and marketing messages. You can opt out of these communications at any time.

For Security and Legal Purposes: We may use your information to detect and prevent fraud, to comply with legal obligations, and to protect our rights and the rights of others.

How We Share Your Information?

With Service Providers: We may share your information with third-party service providers who help us operate our website and provide our services, such as payment processors and data storage providers.  

With Business Partners: We may share your information with business partners who offer complementary services.

With Legal Authorities: We may disclose your information to law enforcement or other government officials in response to a valid request, such as a subpoena or court order.

With Your Consent: We may share your information with other parties with your consent.

Data Security

We take reasonable steps to protect your information from unauthorized access, use, and disclosure. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or method of electronic storage is completely secure.

Your Rights

Access: You can request access to the information we collect about you.  

Correction: You can request that we correct any inaccurate information about you.

Deletion: You can request that we delete your information.

Data Portability: You can request that we provide you with a copy of your information in a portable format.

Opt-Out: You can opt out of receiving marketing communications from us.

Children's Privacy

Our website and tools are not intended for children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13.

Changes to This Privacy Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any material changes by posting the updated policy on our website.
 

Cookies and Tracking

We use cookies to improve your experience. Cookies help us:

  • Understand how users interact with our site.
  • Remember your preferences.
  • Show relevant content or advertisements.

You can disable cookies in your browser settings. However, some features may not work without cookies.

Third-Party Links

Our website may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. Always review their privacy policies before sharing your information.
